purpose: Living source-of-truth for AhB account-backed To-API providers; source lists are not proof of working phone inference.

status_definitions.bundled_verified: Actually packaged and successfully live-tested on Android
status_definitions.bundled_needs_account: Packaged, account requirement not satisfied on device
status_definitions.bundled_quota_blocked: Packaged, account credentials present but known quota-exhaustion failure
status_definitions.bundled_unverified: Actually packaged, device inference not yet verified
status_definitions.new_bundled_pending_build: Source wired for Android prebuilt, build publication and device verification pending
status_definitions.new_optional_installer_unverified: Opt-in runtime installer script exists; no phone package/runtime success confirmed
status_definitions.connector_only: UI/CLI may configure an already-running third-party service but does NOT install it
status_definitions.research_alternative: Overlaps existing candidate/source, keep for fallback
status_definitions.hold_aggregator: Not aligned with AhB account-oriented architecture

candidates.name: OpenCode Zen / Go
candidates.notes: Bundled; real Android OpenCode inference and streaming validated.

candidates.name: FreeBuff / CodeBuff
candidates.notes: Bundled; zero active accounts in device report.

candidates.name: Agent2API WorkBuddy and friends
candidates.notes: Bundled; two credentialed accounts but actual HTTP 503 due low quota.

candidates.name: DeepSeek Web (Go)
candidates.notes: Bundled but disabled; complete real-account inference tests first.

candidates.name: Grok2API
candidates.notes: Bundled Grok2API native Go sidecar. User recalls Grok To API as very stable in prior experience (positive reliability signal; not new AhB on-device proof). Prioritize enabling the existing bundled implementation and verifying actual authorized Grok Web/Build account chat, SSE, full structured tool-call continuation, 401/429/503 and restart persistence. Do not conflate upstream positive reputation with an already passed AhB integration test.

candidates.name: Kiro-Go
candidates.notes: Bundled optional, needs real Android test.

candidates.name: GitHub Copilot minimal Go
candidates.notes: New source code sidecar with optional OAuth, subject to CI ARM64 build and real device test; one account.

candidates.name: Kimi Web multi-account
candidates.notes: EXPERIMENTAL/DEFAULT-OFF. Python Kimi Web with account pool and explicit installation, but user reports historically unstable Kimi Web reverse proxies and upstream README is not optimized for programmatic Tool Calling. Do not promote to production or claim native tools without Android long-run, account-refresh, SSE, two-turn tool-result and 401/429/503 test.

candidates.name: Gemini2API Python

candidates.name: ChatGPT Codex multi-account Go

candidates.name: Codex Proxy Rust

candidates.name: OpenCode GO AgentMux
candidates.notes: OpenCode GO specific multi-account quota-aware Node adapter; incremental only if upstream opencode2api lacks quota/circuit breaker. Avoid redundant pool layers.

candidates.name: 2papi Go subscription gateway
candidates.notes: Single Go executable subscription-account pool plus budgets and MCP; overlaps AhB/ModelAtlas service management rather than a focused adapter.

candidates.name: OperatorLM
candidates.notes: Go single binary but desktop keyring/tray/OpenAI API aggregator; Android OS keyring compatibility unclear.

candidates.name: AIProxy 5.1
candidates.notes: Java 21 JAR account API for Copilot/Codex/Anthropic; larger runtime footprint on Termux vs native Go.

candidates.name: LLM Proxy
candidates.notes: Go multi-backend account pools, 429 recovery and usage UI but duplicates AhB control plane.

candidates.name: Official Kimi Code CLI
candidates.notes: Official login and documented server API; its experimental REST server is not a ready-made OpenAI Chat Completions bridge, can inform quota and OAuth behavior.

candidates.name: ChatGPT Codex OAuth multi-account Go
candidates.notes: Go 1.26.8. Device OAuth, native OpenAI/Anthropic/Responses/stream/tools and model/account quota-aware routing claimed; PRIVATE upstream API can break. Priority candidate only after authorized device login, tool-cycle verification, stable health and MIT license audit.

candidates.name: Codex OAuth API + MCP Go
candidates.notes: Go 1.25.7, MIT; Chat/Responses plus stateless MCP ask_codex. Requires existing authorized Codex CLI login on normal local runtime. MCP tools are one-shot model invocations, NOT full external function-call continuations. Android CLI credential handling unverified. AhB now has a connector-only codex preset at localhost port 9879; NO bundled Codex binary or native login yet.

candidates.name: CodexProxy lean Go
candidates.notes: Go 1.25, lean dependencies, explicit native tool calls and multi-account routing documented; Android OAuth, project license, streaming/full tool cycle not checked.

candidates.name: Codex OpenAI proxy Python
candidates.notes: FastAPI minimal OAuth/PKCE, Chat/Responses/usage, separate Python overhead on Termux; not the preferred lightweight Go candidate.

candidates.name: Codex standalone minimal Rust
candidates.notes: Already known; single binary, Linux RSS claimed tiny; actual Android build and tool-cycle not tested.

candidates.name: ChatGPT Web MCP/CDP
candidates.notes: Operates logged-in Chromium browser over CDP, conversation and attachments as MCP actions; NOT OpenAI-native inference tool-calling and not lightweight Android sidecar.

candidates.name: ChatGPT-Web2API browser REST + MCP
candidates.notes: Python/Chrome/CDP browser-driven REST and MCP; UI selector fragility, login and browser footprint; not a stable Android first-class adapter.

candidates.name: ChatGPT API Web local browser
candidates.notes: Chrome/Playwright persistent browser with OpenAI-style endpoints, explicit selector breakage disclaimer.

candidates.name: ChatGPT Bridge MCP Chrome extension
candidates.notes: MCP->Chromium extension for web session; desktop/browser dependency, not true LLM SDK native tools.

candidates.name: ChatGPT Web Provider browser
candidates.notes: Python browser worker; upstream warns not real token streaming and no full MCP tool loop; do not use for OpenCode-equivalent production.

candidates.name: ChatGPT Web Grok Gemini API
candidates.notes: FastAPI+Next frontend GPT/Grok/Gemini web pools, significant code size and duplicates AhB broad aggregator role; unsafe default admin key if unconfigured.
